title: 3 ft aerodynamic validation tunnel
summary: Designed and fabricated an open-loop subsonic wind tunnel to support aerodynamic testing and compare simulation outcomes with physical behaviour.
objective: Build an open-loop subsonic wind tunnel to support physical evaluation of Formula Student aerodynamic packages.
contribution: Concept development, structural design and analysis, fabrication planning and validation approach.
details: Add your test-section dimensions, fan specification, flow uniformity method, measurement equipment, calibration, and comparison between CFD and physical results.

title: Brake system plausibility device
summary: Worked on a safety circuit concept using signal comparison and fail-safe logic to detect implausible brake and accelerator input conditions.
objective: Develop a safety circuit concept to identify implausible brake and accelerator input conditions.
contribution: Signal conditioning, comparator logic, fail-safe considerations, schematic development and functional testing.
details: Add the relevant rule reference and year, circuit schematic, component selection, threshold calculations, fault cases, test procedure and measured response time.

title: Regulator / rectifier unit
summary: Developed a regulator/rectifier concept focused on stable voltage output, power-device selection and thermal considerations for an automotive application.
objective: Explore a regulated power supply design for an automotive electrical application.
contribution: Power-device selection, voltage regulation concept, thermal management and output stability considerations.
details: Add input/output specifications, circuit diagram, load-test results, heatsink sizing, thermal measurements, protection strategy and limitations.
